contracts.text: `httpx.CookieStore` is a public class accessible as `httpx.CookieStore`.
`CookieStore` can be used in any position that accepts `cookies=`, including `Client(cookies=...)` and `AsyncClient(cookies=...)`.
Existing cookie behavior is unchanged unless `CookieStore` is explicitly used.
`CookieStore.__init__` accepts two optional keyword arguments: `max_cookies` (int or None) and `max_cookies_per_domain` (int or None).
If `max_cookies` or `max_cookies_per_domain` is passed a non-int (and not None), `TypeError` is raised.
If `max_cookies` or `max_cookies_per_domain` is passed a negative int, `ValueError` is raised.
When the per-domain cookie count exceeds `max_cookies_per_domain`, the oldest-by-creation-order cookie for that domain is evicted first.
contracts.adverse_condition: Domain contains multiple cookies with distinguishable creation times; without a domain over the per-domain limit the eviction order cannot be verified.

contracts.text: When the global cookie count exceeds `max_cookies`, the oldest-by-creation-order cookie across all domains is evicted first.
contracts.adverse_condition: Store contains cookies across multiple domains with distinguishable creation times; without exceeding the global limit the eviction order cannot be verified.

contracts.text: Per-domain limit eviction happens before global limit eviction when both limits would be exceeded by a single insertion.
contracts.adverse_condition: A single insertion causes both per-domain and global limits to be exceeded; the ordering of evictions is only observable when both limits are in play simultaneously.

contracts.text: `CookieStore.extract_cookies(response)` parses `Set-Cookie` headers from the response and stores the resulting cookies.
A single `Set-Cookie` header value containing multiple cookies combined with comma separation is parsed correctly, including when an `Expires=` attribute value itself contains a comma.
contracts.adverse_condition: The header value must contain multiple cookies whose boundary comma could be confused with an `Expires` comma; without this specific input shape the comma-handling logic is untested.

contracts.text: Empty cookie strings in `Set-Cookie` are ignored (not stored).
Malformed cookie strings in `Set-Cookie` are ignored (not stored).
A cookie is ignored entirely if a `Domain` attribute appears without a value.
contracts.adverse_condition: The `Set-Cookie` header must contain a `Domain` attribute with no value; without this specific malformed input the rejection cannot be observed.

contracts.text: A cookie is ignored entirely if a `Max-Age` attribute appears without a value.
contracts.adverse_condition: The `Set-Cookie` header must contain a `Max-Age` attribute with no value; without this specific malformed input the rejection cannot be observed.

contracts.text: A cookie is ignored entirely if an `Expires` attribute appears without a value.
contracts.adverse_condition: The `Set-Cookie` header must contain an `Expires` attribute with no value; without this specific malformed input the rejection cannot be observed.

contracts.text: Unknown attributes in `Set-Cookie` are ignored (they do not prevent the cookie from being stored).
Empty cookie values (e.g., `name=`) are valid and stored.
contracts.adverse_condition: The cookie string must have a name with an empty value; without this edge case the handling of empty values is unverified.

contracts.text: A cookie without a `Domain` attribute is host-only: it is sent only to the exact host that set it.
contracts.adverse_condition: Verification requires a request to a different host (including a subdomain of the origin host) where the cookie must not appear.

contracts.text: A cookie with a `Domain` attribute is sent only when the request host domain-matches it (case-insensitive suffix match including a leading dot or not).
contracts.adverse_condition: Verification requires requests to at least a matching domain, a non-matching domain, and the same domain with different case.

contracts.text: A cookie with a `Domain` attribute is sent to subdomains of the specified domain.
contracts.adverse_condition: Verification requires a request to a subdomain of the cookie's domain; without a subdomain request the subdomain-sending behavior is unverified.

contracts.text: When no `Path` attribute is present, the default path is derived from the request path that set the cookie.
contracts.adverse_condition: The deriving request must have a path other than `/`; with only root-path requests the default-path logic cannot be distinguished from a hardcoded `/`.

contracts.text: A `Path` value not starting with `/` (or empty) causes the default path to be used instead.
contracts.adverse_condition: The `Set-Cookie` header must contain `Path=something` where `something` does not start with `/`; without this malformed input the fallback logic is unverified.

contracts.text: Path matching: a cookie with path `/sub` is sent to requests for `/sub` and `/sub/x` but not `/submarine`.
contracts.adverse_condition: Verification requires a request to `/submarine` specifically to confirm the cookie is excluded; `/sub` and `/sub/x` alone cannot distinguish prefix matching from substring matching.

contracts.text: A cookie with the `Secure` attribute is only sent over HTTPS requests.
contracts.adverse_condition: Verification requires both an HTTP and an HTTPS request for the same cookie; the HTTP request must not include the cookie.

contracts.text: When storing, a cookie named with the `__Secure-` prefix is rejected unless it has the `Secure` attribute and the origin is HTTPS.
contracts.adverse_condition: The `Set-Cookie` must bear the `__Secure-` prefix but lack `Secure` or arrive over HTTP; without those conditions the rejection is not triggered.

contracts.text: When storing, a cookie named with the `__Host-` prefix is rejected unless it has `Secure`, the origin is HTTPS, no `Domain` attribute is present, and `Path=/`.
contracts.adverse_condition: The `Set-Cookie` must bear the `__Host-` prefix but violate at least one of: `Secure` missing, HTTP origin, `Domain` present, or `Path` not `/`; without a violation the rejection logic is untested.

contracts.text: `Max-Age` takes precedence over `Expires` when both are present in a `Set-Cookie` header.
contracts.adverse_condition: Both `Max-Age` and `Expires` must be present with conflicting values (e.g., `Max-Age` far future, `Expires` in the past); otherwise the precedence is not observable.

contracts.text: A `Max-Age` value <= 0 deletes an existing matching cookie (same name, domain, path) and does not store a new cookie.
contracts.adverse_condition: A cookie with the same name, domain, and path must already exist in the store; without a pre-existing match the delete side-effect is invisible.

contracts.text: An `Expires` date in the past deletes an existing matching cookie (same name, domain, path).
contracts.adverse_condition: A cookie with the same name, domain, and path must already exist in the store and `Max-Age` must be absent; without a pre-existing match the delete is invisible.

contracts.text: An invalid `Expires` value does not prevent the cookie from being stored (the cookie is stored as if no `Expires` were present).
contracts.adverse_condition: The `Set-Cookie` must contain an unparseable `Expires` string; a valid `Expires` alone cannot test the invalid-handling path.

contracts.text: When a stored cookie is replaced by a new `Set-Cookie` with the same (name, domain, path), it is treated as newly created for eviction ordering purposes.
contracts.adverse_condition: Multiple cookies must already exist with distinguishable creation times; the replacement must cause the updated cookie to become the newest, observable only when an eviction later spares it over an older cookie.

contracts.text: When sending cookies on a request via `set_cookie_header(request)`, cookies are ordered by longer path first, then by older creation time first among cookies with equal path length.
contracts.adverse_condition: At least two cookies with different path lengths and/or different creation times must be eligible; without distinguishable path lengths or creation times the ordering cannot be verified.

contracts.text: When multiple stored cookies share the same name, mapping-style access `store["name"]` raises `httpx.CookieConflict`.
contracts.adverse_condition: At least two cookies with the same name but different domain/path must exist; without a name collision `CookieConflict` is never raised.

contracts.text: `httpx.CookieConflict` is an exception class accessible as `httpx.CookieConflict`.
Mapping-style access `store["name"]` succeeds and returns the value when domain/path disambiguates to a single cookie, even if multiple cookies share the name.
contracts.adverse_condition: Multiple cookies with the same name must exist, but domain and path must select exactly one; without this precise configuration the single-result path is not tested.

contracts.text: `CookieStore` implements the mutable mapping protocol (at minimum `__getitem__`, `__setitem__`, `__delitem__`, `__iter__`, `__len__`).
`CookieStore.set_cookie_header(request)` sets the correct `Cookie` header on the given request object for the cookies that match the request.
`CookieStore.set(name, value, domain="", path="/")` — signature with `domain` defaulting to `""` and `path` defaulting to `"/"`.
Cookies added via `set(name, value, domain="")` (i.e., with the default empty-string domain) are not host-only: they are sent to any host that matches by path and scheme rules.
contracts.adverse_condition: Verification requires requests to at least two different hosts; a single-host test cannot distinguish host-only from non-host-only cookies.

contracts.text: `CookieStore.get(name, default=None, domain=None, path=None)` — signature with `default` defaulting to `None`, `domain` defaulting to `None`, `path` defaulting to `None`.
`CookieStore.delete(name, domain=None, path=None)` — signature.
`CookieStore.clear(domain=None, path=None)` — signature.
`CookieStore.update(cookies)` — signature accepting a single `cookies` argument.
`update(cookies)` accepts `CookieStore` instances as input.
contracts.adverse_condition: The input must be a `CookieStore`; verification requires that the type is accepted without error.

contracts.text: `update(cookies)` accepts `httpx.Cookies` instances as input.
contracts.adverse_condition: The input must be an `httpx.Cookies` instance; verification requires that the type is accepted without error.

contracts.text: `update(cookies)` accepts `http.cookiejar.CookieJar` instances as input.
contracts.adverse_condition: The input must be a `http.cookiejar.CookieJar`; verification requires that the type is accepted without error.

contracts.text: `update(cookies)` accepts `dict[str, str]` as input.
contracts.adverse_condition: The input must be a `dict[str, str]`; verification requires that the type is accepted without error.

contracts.text: `update(cookies)` accepts `list[tuple[str, str]]` as input.
contracts.adverse_condition: The input must be a `list[tuple[str, str]]`; verification requires that the type is accepted without error.

contracts.text: Cookies added via mapping (`dict[str, str]`) or list (`list[tuple[str, str]]`) inputs to `update()` are not host-only: they are sent to any host that matches by path and scheme rules.
contracts.adverse_condition: Verification requires requests to at least two different hosts; a single-host test cannot distinguish host-only from non-host-only cookies.

contracts.text: Cookies added via mapping/list inputs to `update()` are not host-only: same rule as `set()` with `domain=""`.
contracts.adverse_condition: Verification requires requests to at least two different hosts; a single-host test cannot distinguish.

contracts.text: When `get(name, default=None, domain=None, path=None)` is called with `domain` and `path` both `None` and multiple cookies share the name, `CookieConflict` is raised.
contracts.adverse_condition: At least two cookies with the same name must exist; without a collision the conflict path is not tested.

contracts.text: When `get(name, domain=..., path=...)` is called with explicit domain and path, the single matching cookie is returned even if others share the name.
contracts.adverse_condition: Multiple cookies with the same name must exist but domain+path must select exactly one; without this configuration the disambiguation is not tested.

contracts.text: Domain matching is case-insensitive.
contracts.adverse_condition: The cookie's domain and the request host must differ only in casing; same-case matching cannot detect case-insensitivity.
